description: List the vault's tags with usage counts, ordered by count descending and capped at `limit` (default 200) — the response says so when it withheld any. Includes hierarchical parents: `work/tasks` contributes to both `work` and `work/tasks`. Narrow with `nameRegex` for a known prefix or `minCount` to drop the single-use tail. To find notes by tag, use `obsidian_search_notes` in jsonlogic mode (e.g. `{"in": ["work", {"var": "tags"}]}`).

limit.description: Maximum tags to return, applied after `nameRegex` and `minCount` and after ordering by count descending, so the cap keeps the most-used. Max 10000 — high enough to return any real vault whole. When the cap bites, the response reports `truncated`, `shown`, and `cap`.

minCount.description: Keep only tags used at least this many times. Omit (or pass 0) for no filter. On a vault with a long single-use tail this drops it in one argument.

nameRegex.description: Optional ECMAScript regex (no flags, ≤256 chars, no nested quantifiers like `(a+)+`) matched against the bare tag name (no leading `#`). Hierarchical tags like `work/tasks` are matched as the full string. Use character classes (`[Mm]cp`) for case-insensitivity.

name: obsidian_list_tags

appliedFilters.description: Filters and cap that produced this listing.

minCount.description: minCount filter applied to this listing. Absent when none was supplied.

nameRegex.description: nameRegex filter applied to this listing.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `regex_invalid`: The supplied `nameRegex` is not a valid ECMAScript regex. `regex_unsafe`: The supplied `nameRegex` is well-formed but exceeds the 256-character limit or contains nested quantifiers known to cause catastrophic backtracking. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no tags matched the applied filters, when the vault has no tags, or — since `ctx.enrich.truncated` routes its guidance here — when the cap withheld some.

tags.description: Matching tags ordered by `count` descending, ties broken by name ascending, truncated to `appliedFilters.limit`.

items.description: A tag with its usage count.

count.description: Times the tag, or a tag nested under it, occurs across the vault. When OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS is set: the number of readable notes carrying the tag or a tag nested under it.

truncated.description: True when more tags matched the filters than `limit` allowed through.

title: Obsidian List Tags
